parameters.description:
`msg-to-whatsapp-msg` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your WhatsApp destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own WhatsApp destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional WhatsApp destinations bound per enrollment.

WhatsApp setup spans two Meta portals. In Meta Business Manager (business.facebook.com), go to Settings → Users → System Users, create a System User, click "Add Assets" to attach your WhatsApp app, grant it the whatsapp_business_messaging permission, and click "Generate Token" — that permanent token is WHATSAPP_MSG_TOKEN. In the Meta Developer Dashboard (developers.facebook.com), open your app's WhatsApp → API Setup page to find your From Phone Number ID (a ~14-digit numeric ID, not your actual phone number) and set it as WHATSAPP_MSG_FROM_PHONE_ID. Set WHATSAPP_MSG_TO to the recipient's number in E.164 format; sandbox numbers must be verified through Meta's interface first, and production sending requires a verified business.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment WhatsApp destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to the WhatsApp Cloud API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own WhatsApp destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

from_phone_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's WhatsApp from phone id

to_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's WHATSAPP_MSG_TO value (same format as WHATSAPP_MSG_TO)

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's WhatsApp token
